rows: Damage+, No. of Rounds+, Shot Speed+
Damage+, No. of Rounds+, Shot Speed+

β.name: High Angle Fire
β.description: Shoot into the air that curves down to strike the target below. Pierces walls and obstacles above the target area.

γ.name: Kickback Shot
γ.description: Shoot multiple bullets to blow away nearby enemies. Damage decreases while airborne, but you can use the kickback to travel far distances. Hold while in midair to keep adjusting the direction even after taking aim.

normal_tuning.name: Quirk Skill α Attack Power+
normal_tuning.description: Increases damage dealt for Quirk Skill α

normal_tuning.name: Wall Jump HT+
normal_tuning.description: Increases your Wall Jump height

special_tuning.name: Quick Reload
special_tuning.description: Take DOWN an opponent with Quirk Skill α to speed up its reload for a limited time.

α.name: Ice Bullet Shot
α.description: Fires freeze bullets. Enemies hit multiple times become frozen.

β.name: Blackwhip Charge Bolt
β.description: Bind enemy with steel wires and shock with electricity. While binding, press the command again to cancel the move.

γ.name: Drone Anima
γ.description: Release drones to follow yourself. By pressing the command again, shoot one drone in aim direction, or hold to release them all. Can be released while under attack or while doing other actions. Released drones tail enemies and falter after multiple hits. Automatically releases when out of ammo.

rows: Reload Speed+, Active Duration+, Unit Count +

normal_tuning.name: Quirk Skill β Reload+
normal_tuning.description: Increases reload speed of Quirk Skill β

normal_tuning.name: Vertical Jump HT+
normal_tuning.description: Increases your vertical Jump height

special_tuning.name: Foundation of Peace
special_tuning.description: Rescue or threaten citizens, or rescue allies to level up your Quirk Skills.

α.name: Thunder Sepulture
α.description: Fire a laser that pierces opponents. It explodes either on impact or at max range.

β.name: Meteor Annihilation
β.description: Drop dark balls in a straight line ahead. They cause small explosions at the point of impact.

γ.name: Divine Judgment
γ.description: Float in midair. Jump to rise and Crouch to descend. Charge energy in your wings, then release it in a wide blast forward. Dodge to cancel the move, consuming a set amount of ammo.

normal_tuning.name: Quirk Skill γ Defense+
normal_tuning.description: Decreases damage taken from Quirk Skill γ

normal_tuning.name: PU/PC Reload+
normal_tuning.description: Increases PU/PC Gauge filling speed

special_tuning.name: Quirk Factor Release
special_tuning.description: Breaking an opponent's Guard increases Reload Speed for a limited time.

α.name: Delaware Smash Airblast
α.description: Swing your arm wide and release a shockwave. In the air, the damage decreases but leaves you vulnerable for less time.

β.name: Impact 45% Detroit Smash
β.description: Dash quickly in the aim direction and throw a punch. Hold to charge and increase Dash Range. Before Dashing, unleash a Damage Area attack around you.

γ.name: 2nd Transmission
γ.description: Movement Speed and Attack Speed increase. During the effect, input again to move in the aim direction. If you land a ground uppercut, the Effect Time is restored and speed increases. After 3 hits, enter 5th Gear

normal_tuning.name: Run Speed+
normal_tuning.description: Increases your Run speed

normal_tuning.name: Melee Attack Power+
normal_tuning.description: Increases damage dealt for Melee Attacks

special_tuning.name: Acceleration
special_tuning.description: Landing a melee attack increases Movement Speed and Attack Speed for a limited time.
